title: Core engine, allowlist, and module entry

findings.title: effective_config clones entire PrivacyConfig for every call, even when platform=None
action_for_rule is O(M) per match (M = custom_rules.len())
Platform-key matching is case-sensitive — case drift silently falls back to global policy
warn! per PII match floods logs in normal traffic
test_phones() and local_ips() reallocate on every Default::default()
system_email_patterns().clone() in Default deep-clones the regex Vec
sort + dedup are two passes over Vec<PiiMatch> for a job that could be one with a named priority key
init() second-call path is silent and untested
is_provider_excluded does a linear scan over exclude_providers every call
Invalid-offset replacement path logs warn but reports no counter
pub use re-exports of PiiAction/PlatformPiiPolicy/PrivacyConfig have zero callers (dead scaffolding)
